rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial way to describe someone stammering while speaking.

example.english: I stammer whenever I see the boss and can't even get a full sentence out.
example.traditional: 我一見到個老闆就口窒窒，連句說話都講唔完整。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 gin3 dou2 go3 lou5 baan2 zau6 hau2 zat6 zat6 lin4 geoi3 syut3 waa6 dou1 gong2 m4 jyun4 zing2

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing the broken, halting delivery, as in someone speaking with repeated hesitations.

example.english: They stammer when answering questions, making everyone wait a long time.
example.traditional: 佢答問題嗰陣窒吓窒吓咁，搞到大家等咗好耐。
example.jyutping: keoi5 daap3 man6 tai4 go2 zan6 zat6 haa2 zat6 haa2 gam3 gaau2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 dang2 zo2 hou2 noi6
